defs.def: anxious about sth or afraid of sth 焦虑的；担忧的；惶恐的
easily worried or frightened 神经质的；易紧张焦虑的；胆怯的

ex.s: I was desperately nervous when I went to her office the next day.
ex.t: 第二天我去她办公室时紧张得要命。

ex.s: He had never flown by himself before and was very nervous.
ex.t: 他以前从未独自飞行过，非常紧张。

ex.s: Nervously   2   （face） challenges.
The real McNay was splendid， but we felt nervous the whole time we were there． Van Gogh， Picasso． This time， we stayed together， in case anything else unusual happened．
ex.t: 真正的麦克奈庄园很华丽，但我们在那里的整个时间都很紧张。梵高、毕加索。这次，我们待在一起，以防再发生什么不寻常的事。

ex.s: She felt nervous when talking to strangers．
ex.t: B．她和陌生人说话时感到紧张。

ex.s: I woke up sweating and nervous, but ready to prove something to myself.
ex.t: 我醒来时满身是汗、十分紧张，但已准备好向自己证明些什么。

ex.s: A nervous night to be sure, but sometimes the spirits of nature smile on us all!
ex.t: 确是一个紧张的夜晚，但有时自然的精灵会眷顾我们所有人！

ex.s: I started getting really nervous.
ex.t: 我开始变得非常紧张。

ex.s: “I had no idea about what I’d find there and I wasn’t nervous, I just wanted to do it.
ex.t: “我不知道会在那里发现什么，我也不紧张，我只是想去做。”

ex.s: He said he became just as nervous as those playing instruments on stage.
ex.t: 他说他变得和台上演奏乐器的人一样紧张。

ex.s: But he’s, nervous.“I’m here to tell you today why you should … should…”Chris trips on the“-ld,”a. pronunciation difficulty for many non-native English speakers.
ex.t: 但他很紧张。“我今天来是要告诉你们为什么你们应该……应该……”克里斯在“-ld”上绊住了，这是许多非英语母语者的发音难点。

ex.s: What made Chris nervous？
ex.t: 什么让克里斯感到紧张？

ex.s: Some of us were confident and eager take part in the class activity, others were nervous and anxious.
ex.t: 我们中有些人自信而渴望参加班级活动，其他人则紧张焦虑。

ex.s: The instructor kept repeating the word, “Speed up!” “Slow down!” “Turning left!” I was so much nervous that I could hardly tell which direction was left.
ex.t: 教练不停地重复这个词： “加速！“慢点！ ”“向左转！ “我非常紧张，几乎分不清剩下哪个方向。

ex.s: David and I became nervous.
ex.t: 大卫和我变得紧张起来。

ex.s: I had been too nervous to pay attention when he introduced himself!
ex.t: 他们同意立即采取行动。

ex.s: During the English class Meng Hao was nervous about introducing himself in front of the class.
ex.t: 英语课上，孟浩在全班面前做自我介绍时很紧张。

ex.s: Son: (nervously approaching the table) Erm...Dad, can we talk?
ex.t: 儿子： （紧张地走近桌子）呃……爸爸，我们能谈谈吗？

ex.s: We could also say I was very nervous when I saw the test paper.
ex.t: 我们也可以说：当我看到试卷时我非常紧张。

ex.s: Whether I'm at the gym or on the road, my nervous energy pushes me through mile one.
ex.t: 无论是在健身房还是在路上，我那紧张的能量都推着我跑完第一英里。

ex.s: The deep, gentle voice helped calm the nervous girl.
ex.t: 那深沉而温和的声音帮助安抚了紧张的女孩。

defs.def: connected with the body's nerves and often affecting you mentally or emotionally 神经系统的

chunks.cn: 神经质的女孩 / 神经质的夜 / 神经质的能量
